card.title: Withdraw the Objection
card.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please drop the request for a private tea queue. Everyone at the fete uses this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I donated the tent. Can't that count for something?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It does. Your name's on the thank-you board beside the queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody can read it behind that urn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll move the urn. You can accept everyone's thanks while you wait your turn.

mechanism: A gets a donor to accept the public queue by offering recognition through the established thank-you mechanism instead of priority.
confusable: Unlike denying the donor matters, A acknowledges the contribution while refusing a special process.
comparison: Visible donor thanks replace queue privilege, unlike the parcel scene's adapted evidence for an official form.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
